name: Wavetable hoover
desc: Mentasm-style hoover on wt_distorted: pitch-envelope drop on every attack, stereo micro-detune via jux, i-VII-VI-v swells in sparse, a two-bar rave riff alternation in full, octave-canon and reversed-riff fills at peak. Filter blooms over 8-32 cycles.

code.full: note("<[c#3 ~ c#3 [~ c#3] ~ c#3 ~ ~] [c#3 ~ c#3 [~ e3] ~ b2 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_distorted").penv(${slide}).pdec(.12).decay(.3).sustain(.25).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).shape(.25).room(.25).delay(".35:.375:.45").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).jux(x=>x.add(note(.12))).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[c#3 c#3 [~ c#3] e3 ~ c#3 b2 c#3] [c#3 e3 [~ f#3] e3 ~ c#3 [b2 c#3] e3]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_distorted").penv(${slide}).pdec(.1).decay(.25).sustain(.22).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).shape(.3).room(.25).delay(".35:.375:.45").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).jux(x=>x.add(note(.12))).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).lastOf(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(5).play()
